name: io.github.tonyyang0504/jooble-mcp
description: Jooble (jobs): search. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_JOOBLE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Jooble REST API key issued after the request form on https://jooble.org/api/about; it is the last path segment of every call (POST https://jooble.org/api/{api_Key}). Each Jooble country domain has its own key; the free plan is limited to 500 requests per key in total.
